👮 **Wachiman** · review of the whole pull request, at `b12d760`: all 47 files reviewed.

12 finding(s): 2 to fix, 10 to consider; 11 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Outside the diff

- 🟡🧹 **Consider · cleanup: Prepare page's strings left behind with no reader (and new `destEmail`/… are never shown) (confidence medium)** (`packages/i18n/messages/en.json:869`): This PR deletes `pages/prepare/*`, and with it every reader of several `prepare` keys. Searching `apps/kaipu-record/src` turns up no use of `prepareAction`, `prepareActionFull`, `prepareAgain`, `youtubeHint1440`, `youtubeHint4k`, `changePicture`, `dropTitle` ("Drop a video to prepare it"), `dropBody`, `dropActive`, `dropChooseFile` or `dropFromLibrary`. Export uses its own `export.*` keys (`export-drop-zone.tsx:36`). The new `prepare.destEmail`/`lineEmail`/`sayEmail`/`whyEmail` (881–884) exist only to satisfy `DESTINATION_COPY`'s type (`features/prepare/destination-copy.ts:17`). Nothing renders them: `MasterCopiesPanel` resolves names through `destinationOfPreset`, which never returns `email` (`master-copies-panel.tsx:67-68`), and Export names its cards from `export.card*`. Consider dropping the dead keys from both `en.json` and `es.json` so translators don't keep maintaining them. The same applies to `es.json`.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 6.** I reviewed the 13 files in part 1: the router changes, the prepare-path redirect to /export, Email as a new destination on chat's preset, and the new Export page, header, drop zone and destination row. Nothing here blocks the merge, and I made three "consider" suggestions. First, `destinationStep`'s docstring says a held arrow key is ignored, but the code never checks `event.repeat`. Second, the drop zone's \"Pick from Library\" button stays enabled during an import, so the import can finish and take the user away from the video they picked. Third, a destination picked on the screen is never written to `?to=`, so it is lost after opening an existing copy and coming back. The probe has no overall timeout, so a hung file read leaves the screen on \"Reading…\". Prepare behaved the same way, so this change does not cause it.

**Batch 2 of 6.** I reviewed part 2 of 6 and have two findings: one fix and one consider. Nothing here blocks the merge, and I didn't build or run anything.

- **Fix: dropping a file on the Library is no longer caught** (`library-page.tsx:53`). The Library dropped `useFileDrop`, so a file dropped there gets Electron's default handling: the whole window navigates to that file. The PR says this "does nothing". Nothing else blocks it: no other renderer code handles window drops and the main process has no `will-navigate` guard. Confidence is medium: the hook's own comment and the missing guard support it, but I didn't run the app.
- **Consider: an Email export changes its name in Recent exports when it finishes** (`recent-exports.tsx:65`). While running, the row shows Email. Once finished, it is rebuilt from the preset, and `balanced` maps to Slack · Discord.

Nothing to flag in the other three files:
- **`export-stage.tsx`:** the GitHub bar uses the same 10 MB limit as `githubPlans`, and Fill / Fit appears only on the vertical and square cards.
- **`video-picker.tsx`:** it closes on Escape or an outside click like the other pickers, and its keys don't trigger the page's arrow or Enter handling.
- **`destination-detail.tsx` (deleted):** nothing still imports it.

**Batch 3 of 6.** Part 3 has one finding, a "consider" on `shell/sidebar.tsx`.

- **The finding:** the Export rail badge's `onExport` check uses `end: false`, so it also matches `/export/:assetId`. A copy that finishes while the user is on a per-recording Export screen is marked as announced straight away, even though that screen lists no finished copies, so the badge never appears. Using `end: true`, like the Library check below it, would fix this.
- **Deletions:** removing the Prepare page, its list and its drop zone is clean. Nothing in `apps/kaipu-record/src` still imports them.
- **Tests:** the new `use-file-drop.test.tsx` matches what the hook does. The `destinations.test.ts` changes correctly treat email as sharing chat's `balanced` preset, so a `balanced` file maps back to chat.
- **Outside this part:** the doc comment at the top of `ready-copies.ts` still says the Library rail item carries the count.

**Batch 4 of 6.** One finding in part 4, at "fix" severity, medium confidence. The Library test now checks only that a file dropped on the window is not imported. Library no longer mounts any window drop handler, and the drop hook's own doc says Electron then navigates the window to the file. The main process has no navigation guard. So a file dropped on Library (or any page other than Export) replaces the app UI, and any running export in the renderer is lost. The new Export tests and the updated Library-detail route tests (`/prepare` → `/export`) match the code at head.

**Batch 5 of 6.** I reviewed part 5: the deleted Prepare test file and drop-zone stylesheet, the sidebar test, and the new and changed Export stylesheets. Nothing blocks the merge. Every CSS custom property these stylesheets use is defined in packages/tokens or base.css. Every class they declare is used by its component. The scenarios from the deleted Prepare tests are covered again in export-page.test.tsx. Three findings, all \"consider\": the sidebar test titled \"with and without a video\" only checks with a video, and no test covers the badge counting a running export. A low-confidence layout note: with no video open, nothing on the Export screen can scroll, so the drop zone's buttons can be cut off on a short window.

**Batch 6 of 6.** Part 6 (routes, window-size test, Export stylesheets, the deleted Prepare/Library styles, the backlog doc and index row, en/es messages) has no defects.

- **Routes:** `routes.ts` keeps literal values only, so the preload rule holds. The legacy `/prepare` routes redirect with the query kept.
- **Stylesheets:** the new `data-tone` selectors match what `export-stage.tsx` sets.
- **Removed Library keys:** the `importVideo` / `importDrop*` keys no longer have any reader.
- **Docs:** the backlog doc's claims about the redirects and the badge match the code.

Two cleanup notes to consider:
- **Stray comment:** `library-page.module.css` still has the comment for the deleted `.importZone` rule.
- **Unused strings:** several `prepare.*` strings lost their only reader when Prepare was deleted, and the new `prepare.destEmail`/`lineEmail`/`sayEmail`/`whyEmail` are never shown.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (19 closed, 0 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**
- A video dropped on Export, or picked with Browse files, is imported and Export opens on it with the current destination (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:85`) — Export opens on the imported video with ?to= set to the destination. If it fails: Unsupported files are skipped with a toast by useImportVideos. useFileDrop catches the window drop, so Electron does not navigate to the file. A picker selection made during an import gets overridden… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:36-56`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/prepare-path.ts:12-15`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-drop-zone.tsx:40-54`.
- Probing the recording before the stage renders (what bounds the wait) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:92`) — "Reading…" while the probe runs; on failure, a toast and the drop zone. If it fails: No timeout bounds the whole probe. If the kaipu-media:// fetch never resolves, the screen stays on "Reading…" until the user leaves through the sidebar. Prepare behaved the same, so this change does… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:42-67`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/probe-source.ts:28-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:95-99`.
- Enter and the arrow keys on a document-level listener (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:277`) — Enter starts the copy, or opens an existing one. Arrows move the selected card, and focus follows when it was on a card. If it fails: If an export is already running, copy.start shows the busy toast and returns false. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:262-301`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:356-386`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/video-picker.tsx:45-59`.
- Old /prepare and /prepare/:assetId URLs redirect to Export with the query kept (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:168`) — Export screen opens with ?to= preserved. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:17-24`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx:68-74`.
- Starting a copy passes an explicit destination (Email shares chat's preset) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:254`) — The cards say "Email" for an Email copy. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-copy.ts:69-80`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:102-107`.
- Library no longer registers the window-wide file drop handler (useFileDrop removed) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:53`) — The PR says a drop does nothing; with no handler, Chromium/Electron's default navigates the window to the dropped file. If it fails: The app's renderer is replaced by the file view until the user reloads. No error is shown. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-12`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:29-34`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400-403`.
- VideoPicker opens a list of Library originals; Escape or an outside mousedown closes it; picking navigates (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/video-picker.tsx:45-59`) — onPick → openVideo navigates to exportPath(assetId, current destination). If it fails: No async work. While the picker is open, the page's arrow/Enter handlers skip role=dialog and button targets, so the keys don't leak into them. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/tags/tag-chip.tsx:44`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:86-88`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:364`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:384`.
- RecentExports reads the export runner for the in-progress row and the Library for finished copies (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/recent-exports.tsx:34-36`) — The progress percentage updates from the runner's fraction. A finished copy appears once the Library refreshes. If it fails: If the runner errors, status is 'error' and the running row disappears. The error itself is shown by the status cards, not here. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:26-27`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:59`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:71`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:418`.
- DestinationStage primary / Export again buttons and the Fill/Fit and 1440p/4K radios (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:120-141`) — The export starts in the background and the runner's status cards and the rail badge show progress. If it fails: Failures come from usePrepareCopy/runner, which this PR leaves unchanged. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:252-266`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/destinations.ts:110-112`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-presets.ts:257-284`.
- Rail Export item shows a badge: running export (1) plus finished copies not announced yet (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`) — The Export rail item shows the count, with railBadge as its accessible label. The finished copy whose Ready card is showing is not counted. If it fails: On /export/:assetId a copy that finishes is announced at once, even though that screen does not list it, so the badge never appears (see finding). The store is in memory only, so a relaunch clears it… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:114-122`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/ready-copies.ts:50-75`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:319-328`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-runner.ts:460-463`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:101-113`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:252-260`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:17-20`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`.
- Removal of PreparePage, DestinationList and PrepareDropZone (replaced by ExportPage) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/prepare/prepare-page.tsx:1`) — No remaining imports of the deleted modules in the app source; legacy /prepare URLs redirect through LegacyPrepareRedirect. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:94-99`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:167-173`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:375-386`.
- A file from the OS is dropped on the window while the Library page is shown (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.test.tsx:80`) — Nothing is imported. Electron's default for an unhandled file drop navigates the window to the file, replacing the app UI. If it fails: The drop is not handled, and the page is unloaded by the default navigation. Any renderer-hosted background export is lost, with no message to the user. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:8-11`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/hooks/use-file-drop.ts:40-47`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:55`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/library/library-page.tsx:1-33`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/index.ts:400`.
- A video is dropped anywhere on Export (no video, or one open) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:85`) — Export opens on the imported video with ?to= kept, and a toast says how many more videos went into the Library. If it fails: Failures are left to useImportVideos, which this part does not change. The test covers a non-video file showing a toast and not being imported. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/prepare/use-prepare-import.ts:42-56`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:75-88`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:460-525`.
- Opening Export (with or without a video) clears the finished-copy badge, which now sits on the Export rail item instead of Library (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.test.tsx:53`) — The Export rail item shows a count plus the badgeLabel "N copy/copies in progress or ready" (en.json:946). The count is the running export plus unannounced copies, minus the one shown in the ready card. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:111-123`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:79-81`, `packages/i18n/messages/en.json:946`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.test.tsx:44-70`.
- Removed PreparePage tests; their coverage moved to the Export page tests (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:132`) — export-page.test.tsx re-covers the old Prepare scenarios: busy runner, unreadable probe, screenshots, existing copy, unexported edits, drop/import of one, several and non-video files, and old Prepare URLs. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:319-386`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.test.tsx:460-511`.
- Legacy `/prepare/:assetId` and `/prepare` URLs redirect to `/export/:assetId` / `/export`, keeping the query (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/routes.ts:21-24`) — The user lands on Export with the destination from `?to=` preselected. Because of `replace`, the old URL is not left in history, so Back does not bounce through the redirect. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/app/router.tsx:68-74`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-page.tsx:168-173`.
- New `/export` and `/export/:assetId` routes get the main window preset (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/window-size.test.ts:21-22`) — Moving between Export and the other sidebar pages does not resize the window. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/window-size.ts:82-86`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/window-size.test.ts:14-32`.
- Size bar tone via `data-tone` (lighter/not-lighter/fits/over) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.module.css:262-291`) — The tag and fill are teal when the copy is lighter or fits, and amber when it is not lighter or is over the limit. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/pages/export/export-stage.tsx:299-330`.
- Rail badge cleared on opening Export or the Library (as the backlog doc claims) (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/backlog/export-screen.md:26-28`) — The badge sits on the EXPORT entry. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:53`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:79`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:107`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/shell/sidebar.tsx:115-118`.

</details>
